Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. 
As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.
Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.
About the role
Almost any company can produce training video at scale today. Almost none can tell you whether it actually made someone better at their job. We're building the product that closes that gap: an agentic, real-time experience where people practice live, dynamic scenarios, and where organizations finally get genuine signal on readiness, instead of a metric tied to course completion. This is a zero-to-one bet on what comes after content, which is practice, and proof.
You'll own one of two of the domains inside that bet, Surveys and Guidance, from strategy through ship.
Why now
Real-time, agentic AI has only just become good enough to hold a convincing live scenario, and to make sense of what happens inside one. The window to define this category is open now, and we intend to own it.
The problem you're solving
Today, the most a company can do to check whether someone has genuinely learned something is watch them complete a module or pass a quiz. The behaviors that matter in real roles, in real moments, are rarely tested reliably, and what comes back to the business is a thin, lagging signal.
We have the underlying technology to change that. What we need is a product manager who can turn it into something an enterprise will use to prepare its people, and that an end user actually wants to engage with, across two connected domains:
Surveys - capturing structured, trustworthy signal at scale: how people feel, how they're performing, and where the gaps are.
Guidance - giving people direction in the moment they need it, live and in context, rather than as a debrief after the fact.
Both sit inside the same bet: give organizations proof of readiness, not just proof of attendance.
What you'll be doing
Owning the multi-quarter strategy for Surveys and Guidance, setting the direction, identifying the right problems to solve, and making the trade-offs needed to deliver against them.
Defining and evolving the success metrics for both domains, and connecting product outcomes directly to commercial results: retention, expansion, and revenue impact.
Getting close to the customers who matter most: understanding how they think, where current tools leave them exposed, and translating that into a product direction others can act on.
Driving a shared understanding of where these product areas are going and why. Engineering, design, R&D, and commercial counterparts should all be able to articulate the strategy and the reasoning behind it.
Producing written narratives, strategy docs, and PRDs, that move decisions forward and give your team the context to build the right thing without a follow-up conversation.
Balancing short-term delivery with long-term product health: scoping to reflect execution risk, hitting milestones predictably, and iterating based on evidence rather than opinion.
Contributing to improvements in product practice across the team, and actively participating in PM hiring.
Who you are
You've owned a critical product domain before, one where the stakes were real and the strategy was yours to set, not just execute. You're comfortable operating with autonomy on the what, not just the how, and you have a track record of connecting product decisions to commercial outcomes.
You understand that zero-to-one products in complex domains require you to hold two things at once: the discipline to deliver predictably in the short term, and the judgment to make the right long-term bets while the evidence is still forming. You don't wait for a clean brief. You identify the right problems, form a view, and bring others along.
You're a strong written communicator. Engineering and design partners, commercial leads, and senior leadership should all come away from your docs and updates with a clear understanding of where the domain is going and why, without needing to ask.
You care about the quality of the experience. Real-time, agentic products are unforgiving, and you hold a high bar for what "good" feels like, for the user in the moment and for the customer looking at outcomes.
You may be a good fit if you bring
Significant experience in product management, with direct experience owning a critical product domain: setting strategy, not just executing it.
A track record of connecting product outcomes to commercial results: ARR, retention, expansion, or equivalent.
Experience with zero-to-one product development in a complex, experience-driven space. You've navigated the ambiguity of a zero-to-one build and have the scar tissue to show for it.
Experience building agentic or AI-powered products. You understand what makes real-time AI interactions feel natural, and what breaks them.
Strong written communication: strategy docs, PRDs, and decision memos that others can act on without a follow-up conversation.
Experience working alongside enterprise buying motions. You'll be close to the commercial team, and that context matters.
We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every point above. Strong candidates rarely match a list exactly, and we'd rather hear from you.

**See something that should exist? Build it.  
See a better way? Do it.**

At **Terrific**, every role directly impacts how we grow from product to revenue to customer experience. We’re building the next generation of social commerce through live shopping powered by real-time data and AI.

And we believe customer data should belong to the brands who earn it — not third-party platforms.

# **Product Engineer — Monetization & Commerce Data**

Europe · Remote · Full-time Contract  
Product & Engineering · Commerce Media · Data · AI  
Start date: November 2026

**See data that should be worth money? Make it worth money.**  
**See a number nobody can explain? Go find out why.**

At **Terrific**, we're building the next generation of social commerce—helping brands and publishers turn content, creators, live experiences and AI into commerce they own.

Our technology brings shoppable video, live shopping, interactive timelines, polls and product carousels directly onto a merchant's website or app.

Now we're looking for a **Product Engineer** to turn what those experiences already know about a shopper into a monetization product—and to decide what that product should be.

## THE OPPORTUNITY

This is not a role where you'll inherit a roadmap.

You'll write it.

Terrific sits on something most advertising companies cannot get. On a single customer's domain we see the video someone watched, the poll they voted in, the product they tapped, the coupon they used, what went into the cart and what they actually bought—first-party, consented, tied to a real catalog and a real checkout.

Most advertising systems have one half of that and model the other half.

Nobody has turned it into a product yet.

That's this role. You'll build the layer that lets a retailer sell advertising inside their own site to the brands they already stock, and lets a publisher prove what their audience is worth in transactions rather than impressions.

There is no ad server today. No auction. No campaign model. No advertiser interface. It is a blank page, and you get to decide what goes on it.

## WHAT YOU'LL BUILD

First, the thing only we can build: measurement.

Impression, view, engagement, product interaction, add to cart, checkout, purchase. Client-side and server-side. One canonical event model, identity resolution, consent, and reporting a brand manager can read without an analyst.

Then the thing that makes money: on-site retail media. Sponsored placements on inventory we already control—timeline, shoppable video, live—sold to brands the retailer already stocks. No auction required. No ad server required.

After that, connectivity. Campaign and audience APIs into external buying platforms, and eventually programmatic supply through Google Ad Manager and Prebid.

We expect to rent more of the advertising stack than we build. You'll help decide which parts.

## WHAT YOU'LL OWN

* Writing the spec. You get a problem and an account, not a ticket.
* Designing the event model across every Terrific surface—video, live, timeline, polls, chat, cart, checkout.
* Identity resolution and consent, built so our customers keep their data structurally and not only contractually.
* Attribution: connecting advertising exposure to transactions, and being able to defend the method to a customer in one sentence.
* Reconciliation between third-party reporting and our own logs, which never match.
* The advertiser-facing surface—campaign setup, pacing, delivery, reporting.
* Sponsored placement delivery and ranking on Terrific inventory.
* Build-versus-rent recommendations, including which providers you'd shortlist.
* Instrumenting what you ship and watching it get used.
* Deciding what not to build this year, and saying so out loud.

You won't be expected to know advertising technology on day one. You will be expected to form an opinion, test it cheaply, and change it when the evidence says so.

## WHO YOU ARE

You're an engineer who thinks in products.

You've shipped data systems that carried real volume, not prototypes. You're comfortable with Node.js and TypeScript, strong SQL, and event pipelines—BigQuery and Pub/Sub, or close enough that you'll be fluent in a week.

You know what's actually buildable, how long it will take, and when to simplify scope to get something real into production faster. That last part is the job, not a compromise.

You care about the product and not only the code—which means you'll push back when what you've been asked for doesn't make sense.

You can sit with a retailer's analytics lead, work out what they actually need to see, and go build it without a product manager in between.

And you're honest about numbers. In advertising, almost everyone's numbers are slightly wrong and most people don't say so. We'd rather be the ones who can explain the difference.

## HOW YOU'LL USE AI

Terrific is AI-native by default.

We don't treat AI as a separate initiative or an occasional productivity tool. We use it as part of how we investigate, build, document and improve our work.

In this role, you'll have the freedom to use AI to:

* Prototype a data model in an afternoon instead of a sprint.
* Generate and test transformation and reconciliation logic.
* Explore a customer's catalog, feed or event stream quickly.
* Draft the specs and documentation you'd otherwise postpone.
* Build internal tools that let commercial teams answer their own data questions.
* Monitor pipelines and catch discrepancies before a customer does.

We're interested in what you can build with AI—not whether you use a particular tool.

Use it to move significantly faster. Don't outsource your judgment to it.

## WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

* At least five years building production data or backend systems.
* Node.js and TypeScript. Strong SQL.
* Real event-pipeline experience—BigQuery, Pub/Sub, or close equivalents.
* Experience owning something end to end: you decided what it should do, then built it.
* Ability to design a data model someone else can still understand a year later.
* Clear written communication. You'll write specs other people build from.
* Good judgment about effort, risk and commercial value.
* Comfort working independently within a distributed, international team.
* Professional fluency in English.

**A strong advantage:**

* You've joined advertising exposure data to transaction data before.
* Attribution, identity resolution, clean rooms, or conversion APIs.
* Retail media, commerce media, or publisher monetization.
* Analytics or reporting products used by non-technical customers.
* Spanish, Portuguese or French for our LATAM and EMEA accounts.

You do not need to have built an SSP, and you don't need ad-operations history. If you've built serious data products and you can hold a product argument, the advertising domain is learnable and we'll teach it.

## HOW WE HIRE

No take-home project. About four hours of your time in total.

* A call with the hiring manager. Thirty minutes.
* **A pairing session in our actual codebase**, with one of our engineers. One hour. Not a whiteboard, not an algorithm puzzle.
* **A product judgment conversation.** We give you a real scenario: a retailer with five million monthly sessions, a product catalog, purchase data, Terrific inventory and Google Ad Manager, who wants brands to buy sponsored placements and wants purchases attributed to the advertising. We want to hear what you'd build first, what you'd refuse to build in year one, and where you'd cut scope.
* A technical design conversation. One hour.

We'll tell you what we're assessing before each round, and we'll give you feedback either way.

## SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In your first months, you will:

* Ship an event and identity layer that covers every Terrific surface.
* Produce the first attributed revenue number a customer actually trusts.
* Put a working sponsored-placement product in front of one retailer's brand partners.
* Give our commercial teams numbers they can sell on.
* Recommend what we build and what we rent—and be right often enough that we stop asking twice.
* Leave behind a data model the next three engineers don't want to replace.

Success is not shipping every item on a roadmap.

Success is a retailer being able to say "advertising on my own site produced this much revenue"—and prove it.

## WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

Most engineering roles in advertising begin with a ticket and end when the ticket is closed.

This one begins with a blank page.

You'll decide what the product is, not only how it gets implemented. You'll work directly with customers, with the people making commercial decisions, and inside a company that already has the data—just not yet the product.

The advertising industry spends enormous effort modeling what Terrific observes directly.

You'll be the one who turns the observation into revenue.

* Available for a full-time engagement.

Terrific operates as a global company, and English is our primary business language. Interviews, documentation and regular internal communication will be conducted in English.

# **Help fix customer-centricity at scale**

Every company wants to become more customer-centric. At TheyDo, we make that ambition real. Our AI-powered journey management platform helps the world’s largest enterprises align around what matters most: their customers. By bringing scattered data and teams together, we empower smarter decisions and better experiences. Backed by $50M from top-tier investors, including Blossom and 20VC, we are building a category-defining company. Our fully remote team of 100+ TheyDoers represents 30+ nationalities across 27 countries, united by a customer-led, people-first culture.  
  
Our mission is clear: Make journey management the most powerful business tool in the world.

If you’re looking for a place where your work shapes the future of how companies operate, join us. Let’s build it together.

Most AI features are a prompt box bolted onto an existing product. We're after something harder: AI that does real work inside a customer's journey, and that enterprise teams trust to do it. That trust is a design problem before it's an engineering one, and it's the problem we want you to own.

You'll be the designer on our Intelligence team, the group defining the next phase of TheyDo's agentic platform. We've built the foundations. Now the work is deepening how much value that AI creates within Journey Management. This is a role for someone who shapes what we build, not someone waiting for a spec to land on their desk.

# Why this role, now

TheyDo is Journey Management: the platform where large organizations map their customers' end-to-end experience, agree on the right opportunities, and align teams around them. Our users are design-savvy CX and product professionals working inside complex enterprises.

AI is central to where the product goes next. We've laid the groundwork, and the next chapter is about making that intelligence a trusted, everyday collaborator in how our customers understand and improve their journeys. It's an open, fast-moving design space, and the shape of it isn't settled. That's why we're hiring someone to help define it.

# What you'll define

You'll help set the direction for how people and AI work together inside TheyDo, and turn that direction into experiences we ship.

* **The human–AI relationship.** Design how our customers collaborate with AI inside a journey: where a person stays in the driver's seat, where the product can take more off their plate, and how that balance shifts as trust grows.
* **Trust and control as craft.** The moments where someone reviews, steers, approves, or reverses what the AI does are the heart of this work. They're the difference between AI that feels safe and AI that feels risky.
* **New interaction patterns.** Define how people express intent and get intelligent, dependable results in a space that mostly doesn't have established patterns yet, including the unglamorous parts: waiting, cost, and what happens when something comes back wrong.
* **From capability to experience.** Partner closely with PM, engineering, and research to understand what's newly possible, how fast that's changing, and how to turn it into something our users find genuinely useful.
* **A coherent system.** Establish the patterns that become part of TheyDo's design language as this area matures, so the rest of the product can build on them.

* Sit at the front of the roadmap: turn an ambiguous, fast-moving space into concrete bets, and make the case for them with prototypes rather than documents.
* Prototype constantly, including with AI. We're an AI-forward team, so using AI to move faster in your own craft is already how we work.
* Talk to users constantly: interviews, sales and customer success calls, and our design community, especially the practitioners betting their work on our product.
* Ship high-quality, end-to-end experiences and help evolve the design system as new patterns mature.
* Raise the bar beyond your own work and help establish how AI experience design is done here.

* A strong product designer with a portfolio that shows judgment on ambiguous, 0→1 problems, not just polished screens.
* **Real fluency with AI first design process.** You've designed and prototyped *with* modern models to generate concepts, which you translate into an embedded, thoughtful solutions in a product.
* Someone who **ideates proactively**. You go find the important problem and bring a point of view, rather than waiting for requirements to be handed over.
* A strong prototyper who makes things real instead of describing them, and who is comfortable being early, being wrong in public, and changing their mind quickly.
* Systems thinking: you can define a new interaction pattern, explain its consequences, and know when to break your own rules.
* Comfort with complexity and enterprise constraints. You treat trust, control, and scale as the interesting part of the problem.
* Experience with B2B or otherwise complex software. Familiarity with customer journeys, service design, or research practices is a real plus.

highest-priority European markets — the United Kingdom, Germany, and the Netherlands. You own

every payroll tax filing, every statutory remittance, and every proof of payment for these countries from

shape how statutory compliance is managed at a fast-growing global employment platform.

declarations to Belastingdienst, conducting three-way reconciliations after every cycle, managing tax

notices when they arise, and staying continuously ahead of legislative changes across your region.

and wants to work in an environment where your expertise genuinely matters — this is the role for you.

HMRC obligations (UK), ELSTER and Lohnsteuer/Sozialversicherung (Germany), or

Loonheffingen and Belastingdienst requirements (Netherlands). Knowledge of all three is strongly

preferred.

● Direct experience preparing, submitting, and managing statutory payroll filings — not just

overseeing them, but personally owning the process end to end.

● Experience managing statutory tax notices — drafting responses, coordinating with regulatory

authorities, and resolving disputes within statutory timeframes.

● Demonstrated experience in multi-country payroll compliance — managing multiple jurisdictions

simultaneously with different filing cadences and regulatory frameworks.

● Track record of meeting 100% of statutory deadlines in a high-volume, fast-paced payroll

environment.

### Description

At UVeye, we’re on a mission to redefine vehicle safety and reliability on a global scale. Founded in 2016, we pioneered the world’s first fully automated suite of vehicle inspection systems. At the heart of this innovation lies our advanced AI-centric technology, representing the pinnacle of computer vision, machine learning, and generative AI within the automotive sector.

With over $380M in funding and strategic partnerships with industry giants such as Toyota, Amazon, General Motors, Volvo, and Hertz, our technology is utilized in manufacturing plants, dealerships, wholesale auctions, delivery fleets, seaports, and more. Our growing global team of 250+ employees is committed to creating a workplace that celebrates diversity, encourages teamwork, and strives for excellence.

We’re looking for a ***Field Service Engineer*** to join our growing UK Operations Team, supporting customer sites across the UK and Europe. In this hands-on, high-impact role, you’ll lead on-site installations, direct third-party contractors as the Lead FSE, troubleshoot and maintain our systems, and serve as a key technical point of contact for our customers. You’ll play a critical role in delivering a safe, high-quality installation and service experience while representing UVeye professionally in the field. This role requires strong technical judgement, a customer service mindset, excellent communication skills, and the ability to adapt quickly and solve problems in a fast-paced, constantly evolving environment.

**A day in the life and how you’ll make an impact:**

* Own the on-site execution of new UVeye system installations from **site readiness and installation** through testing, commissioning, and customer handoff
* Act as the Lead FSE on assigned installations, coordinating and directing third-party contractors and ensuring work is completed safely, accurately, on schedule, and to UVeye standards
* Serve as UVeye’s primary on-site technical point of contact, building strong relationships with customers, communicating progress and issues, managing expectations, and ensuring a professional customer experience
* Assess site readiness before and during installation, review site layouts and technical requirements, and identify infrastructure, electrical, networking, civil works, or other conditions that could impact successful deployment
* **Install, configure, test, and validate** UVeye hardware and supporting systems to ensure equipment is fully operational and ready for customer use
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, networking, electrical, and mechanical issues in real time, taking ownership of issues through resolution or coordinating the appropriate internal resources when escalation is required
* Perform preventative, corrective, and emergency maintenance across existing customer sites, diagnosing system issues and restoring equipment to normal operation as efficiently as possible
* Maintain responsibility for safety while leading work on site, including identifying hazards, following site-specific requirements, ensuring appropriate PPE is used, and addressing or escalating unsafe conditions
* Partner closely with Operations, Support, Engineering, Customer Success, and other internal teams to communicate field conditions, resolve technical issues, and support successful customer deployments
* Complete accurate and timely installation, commissioning, maintenance, and service documentation, including work performed, technical findings, outstanding issues, and required follow-up
* Identify recurring technical or operational issues observed in the field and provide feedback to internal teams to help improve installation processes, system reliability, and the overall customer experience

### Requirements

* 4+ years of experience as a Field Service Engineer, Field Engineer, Field Technician, or similar role involving hardware/software installation, deployment, or maintenance
* Proven experience leading contractors or teams during technical installations
* Strong hands-on skills across civil works, networking, electrical wiring, and mechanical assemblies
* Working knowledge of Linux-based systems and basic networking principles
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work effectively and make sound decisions under pressure
* Demonstrated ability to write clear installation, service, and maintenance documentation
* Previous experience using AutoCAD, Autodesk, or similar software to interpret site layouts
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to lead on-site discussions and provide clear direction to customers, contractors, and internal stakeholders
* Strong customer service mindset with the ability to build trust, manage expectations, and represent UVeye professionally
* Strong safety mindset with the confidence to identify, address, and escalate safety concerns
* Resilience and adaptability when working in changing field environments
* Ability and willingness to meet the travel requirements of the role
* Valid driving licence

**Ideally, we’re looking for:**

* Experience working in a startup or fast-growing company
* Certified electrician qualification or relevant electrical experience
* Degree or technical qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
* Experience with CAD software
* Experience in the automotive industry
* Additional scripting, networking, or advanced troubleshooting knowledge

**Physical & Travel Requirements:**

This is a field-based role requiring extensive travel to customer and installation sites across the UK and Europe. Weekly overnight travel is an essential requirement of the position, with the frequency and duration of travel varying based on customer, installation, and operational needs. The role may also require occasional work outside standard business hours depending on site or service requirements.

Work environments may include vehicle service areas, rental facilities, dealerships, manufacturing sites, warehouses, and other commercial or industrial locations. The role may involve extended periods of standing or walking, bending, reaching, and occasional manual handling, including lifting or carrying equipment and tools up to 40 kg. Employees are expected to follow applicable site safety requirements and use personal protective equipment (PPE) when required. *Reasonable adjustments may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

**Why UVeye**

* Tech-First Mindset: Join a team at the forefront of innovation, where cutting-edge technology is shaping the future of AI and redefining the automotive industry.
* Industry Leadership: Be part of a trailblazing company driving real change—backed by rapid growth, a track record of success, and strong partnerships with global industry leaders.
* People-Centered Culture: Thrive in a collaborative, inclusive environment that values initiative, supports growth, and provides unique opportunities for development through executive workshops and mentorship programs.

UVeye is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.

Contribute to analytical and investigative activities such as FMEA, Hazard Analysis and Risk Control, and RCA. Integrate these and associated methodologies into the development, execution and analysis of experiments and tests.

Execute experiments and tests or oversee their execution by technicians, as required.

## Project Summary

A private equity-backed portfolio company operating in the entertainment sector—specifically in arcades, attractions, and experiential venues—is seeking a highly capable and strategic Data Analyst to lead its analytics efforts and drive forward pricing initiatives. This role is designed for a consultant who can take full ownership of the data analytics function, transforming raw consumer data into actionable insights that inform pricing strategy, operational decisions, and investor reporting.

The company is undergoing a period of rapid growth and transformation, and data has become a critical asset in shaping its future. The Data Analyst will serve as the bridge between Sales Operations (currently the sole data owner) and the broader deal team, including private equity stakeholders. By assuming responsibility for the end-to-end analytics workflow, this individual will free up the SalesOps lead to focus on higher-level initiatives while ensuring that data-driven decision-making becomes a core competency across the organization.

This is a high-impact role that requires a blend of technical expertise, strategic thinking, and strong communication skills. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working with large consumer datasets, designing pricing experiments, building dashboards, and presenting insights to both internal leadership and external investors.

### 

## Key Responsibilities

### 1. End-to-End Analytics Workflow Ownership

The Data Analyst will be responsible for managing the entire lifecycle of data analytics within the organization. This includes:

* **Data Extraction:** Pulling consumer data from various sources such as point-of-sale systems, CRM platforms, ticketing systems, and third-party integrations.
* **Data Structuring:** Cleaning, organizing, and transforming raw data into structured formats suitable for analysis.
* **Data Analysis:** Applying statistical techniques, segmentation models, and predictive analytics to uncover trends, patterns, and opportunities.
* **Reporting:** Creating reports and visualizations that communicate insights clearly and effectively to stakeholders.

This workflow must be scalable, repeatable, and adaptable to future business needs. The analyst will be expected to implement best practices in data governance, documentation, and version control.

### 2. Dashboard and Report Development

A key deliverable of this role is the creation of dashboards and reports that surface insights for executive decision-making. Responsibilities include:

* Designing intuitive dashboards using tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
* Automating reporting processes to reduce manual effort and improve efficiency.
* Developing custom reports tailored to the needs of different stakeholders, including operations, finance, and investor relations.
* Ensuring that all visualizations are accurate, up-to-date, and aligned with business objectives.

The analyst should be able to translate complex data into simple, actionable visuals that drive strategic conversations.

### 3. Pricing Strategy and Experimentation

The company is actively exploring new pricing models to optimize revenue and enhance customer engagement. The Data Analyst will play a central role in this initiative by:

* Designing and executing pricing experiments, such as measuring “willingness to play” based on credit spend, time of day, location, and customer demographics.
* Analyzing the impact of pricing changes on key metrics such as foot traffic, average spend per visit, and customer retention.
* Collaborating with the deal team to model different pricing scenarios and forecast their financial implications.
* Providing recommendations on pricing tiers, bundling strategies, and promotional offers based on data-driven insights.

This work will directly influence the company’s revenue strategy and its ability to scale profitably.

### 4. Cross-Functional Collaboration

The Data Analyst will work closely with multiple teams across the organization, including:

* **Sales Operations:** Partnering to understand existing data structures, pain points, and opportunities for improvement.
* **Private Equity Deal Team:** Aligning analytics outputs with investor priorities and reporting requirements.
* **Marketing and Finance:** Supporting campaigns, budgeting, and forecasting with relevant data insights.

Strong interpersonal skills are essential, as the analyst will need to navigate both technical and non-technical environments, build trust with stakeholders, and drive alignment across functions.

### 5. Presentation and Communication

The ability to communicate insights effectively is just as important as the analysis itself. The Data Analyst will be expected to:

* Present findings in a clear, compelling manner tailored to the audience—whether internal leadership or external investors.
* Create executive summaries, slide decks, and visual aids that support strategic discussions.
* Translate complex data concepts into business language that drives action.
* Respond to ad hoc requests for analysis and provide rapid turnaround on urgent data needs.

This role demands a high level of professionalism, clarity, and responsiveness in all communications.

### 

## Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate for this role will possess a unique combination of technical proficiency, strategic insight, and communication skills. Specific qualifications include:

* **Strong Background in Data Analytics**
  + Experience working with large consumer datasets in a business context.
  + Proficiency in statistical analysis, data modeling, and machine learning techniques.
  + Ability to design and execute complex analyses that yield actionable insights.
* **Expertise in Pricing Analytics**
  + Familiarity with pricing strategy development, revenue management, and behavioral economics.
  + Experience conducting A/B tests, elasticity modeling, and customer segmentation.
  + Understanding of how pricing impacts consumer behavior and business performance.
* **Advanced Technical Skills**
  + Proficiency in SQL for data extraction and manipulation.
  + Experience with Python, R, or Alteryx for advanced analytics and automation.
  + Comfort with data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Looker.
  + Excel proficiency is expected, but not sufficient—must be able to work with more advanced environments.
* **Consulting Experience**
  + Manager-level consulting experience preferred, ideally with exposure to strategic projects in consumer-facing industries.
  + Ability to balance hands-on execution with high-level strategic thinking.
  + Experience presenting to C-suite executives and investor stakeholders.
* **Strong Communication Skills**
  + Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
  + Experience working in private equity environments or high-stakes business settings.
  + Skilled in storytelling with data and influencing decision-makers.

## Tools & Technologies

The candidate should be proficient in the following tools and platforms:

* **Data Extraction & Transformation:** SQL, Alteryx, Python, R
* **Visualization & Reporting:** Tableau, Power BI, Looker, Google Data Studio
* **Data Storage & Management:** Excel, Google Sheets, cloud databases
* **Experimentation & Modeling:** A/B testing frameworks, regression analysis, clustering algorithms
* **Collaboration Tools:** Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, Microsoft Teams

### 

## Success Metrics

The success of this engagement will be measured by:

* The creation of a scalable, repeatable analytics workflow that supports ongoing business needs.
* The development of dashboards and reports that are actively used by executives and investors.
* The successful execution and analysis of pricing experiments that inform strategic decisions.
* The reduction of manual data handling by SalesOps and improved cross-functional collaboration.
* The clarity and impact of insights presented to stakeholders.

## Staff / Senior Staff Security Engineer, Vinted Pay

## **Brief info about Vinted**

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life – or even a third.   
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:  
  
**Vinted Marketplace** is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.  
  
**Vinted Go** enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.  
  
**Vinted Pay** is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.  
  
Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people.

## **Information about the position**

As Staff / Senior Staff Security Engineer in Vinted Pay, you will be the staff-level security engineer inside our regulated payments business - and the person who makes Vinted Pay's security posture match its growth. Vinted Pay is a rare security problem in the best sense: a fintech scaling across multiple European licences at marketplace speed, where security cannot be a compliance checklist or an isolated engineering task - it has to be built into the core financial architecture. Its attack surface spans multi-region AWS infrastructure, payment pipelines and payment pages, wallets holding members' money, the cardholder and personal data behind them, and a regulatory perimeter - PCI DSS, DORA, Bank of Lithuania and FCA rules - that rises every year.

Working at staff / senior staff level as an individual contributor embedded in the Payments Engineering leadership team, you will own the security of that whole estate. Vinted Security runs a federated model: the central team sets thresholds and provides core services (pentesting, threat intelligence, SSDLC tooling, compliance), while each business unit owns local execution. Vinted Pay already owns part of its local execution; your job is to lead and scale it - this is not a policy or audit role, it is an engineering role with a mandate: translate regulatory requirements into technical guardrails and drive practical controls alongside Vinted Pay's platform and software engineers. You will work directly with Vinted Pay's Director of Engineering and functionally with the Vinted Security senior team and your security peers in Marketplace, Vinted Go, and Platform.

This is a build role with room to grow: you start hands-on, closing the highest-impact gaps yourself and setting direction for the security work already under way, and as the function matures you will shape and functionally lead Vinted Pay's security engineering capability.

## **In this position, you’ll**

* Own the Vinted Pay security roadmap end to end: assess the estate, prioritise by real attack paths, and drive risks to closure - a multi-quarter roadmap that shapes how Vinted Pay defends its infrastructure and payment assets, rather than reacting to the next audit.
* Turn regulation into engineering: map PCI DSS, DORA, and Bank of Lithuania and FCA requirements into practical, automated security controls and engineering guardrails - compliance as a by-product of how Vinted Pay builds, not a parallel workstream.
* Find and close the operational blind spots: run deep technical reviews of our AWS infrastructure, payment pipelines, SIEM and logging, and vulnerability management tooling (e.g. Wiz), and fix what you find - prioritised by exposure, not by finding count.
* Own PCI DSS and data protection architecture: payment page isolation, script monitoring, data encryption, and least-privilege access across multi-region environments - and turn those controls into evidence that stands up to assessors and regulators.
* Lead cross-functional security initiatives across Payments Platform, Payments Engineering, and Group Security, and drive them to delivery - whether execution sits with partner teams or you have to write the code yourself.
* Act as the technical arm of Vinted Pay's security accountable: maintain the risk register, prepare mitigation-or-acceptance decisions against centrally set thresholds, and represent Vinted Pay in the group's security governance.
* Embed secure development into Payments engineering so security lands at design time rather than after deployment, and raise the security fluency of Vinted Pay engineers so risk-based decisions happen well without you in the room - security as a delivery enabler, not a gate.

## **About you**

* Strong hands-on security engineering experience on a real engineering foundation - you have built or run large production systems, and you can threat-model a payment flow, find the attack path yourself, and drive or build the fix.
* Experience in regulated payments or fintech - you have worked under PCI DSS and a financial regulator (FCA, Bank of Lithuania, CSSF, or equivalent) and know how their requirements become controls engineers actually run.
* A staff- or principal-level track record - you have defined, led, and delivered major, company-wide technical initiatives, and you set security direction through software design on high-scale, distributed systems rather than from the outside.
* The range to move across the four archetypes of staff engineering - tech lead, architect, solver, right hand - picking the one the domain needs together with the Director of Engineering, not the one you prefer.
* A way of working that engineers respect: evidence over assertions, attack paths over checklists, guardrails over gates.
* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority and translate technical risk into business consequence for senior audiences, internal and external.
* Comfortable in our stack - Ruby on Rails, Go, MySQL, Temporal, AWS, SIEM and CSPM tooling - or eager to learn it, with a real interest in security and privacy as a field and the appetite to keep growing as an engineer and leader.
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Advantage: experience building and running systems at massive scale (2+ million requests per minute), deep knowledge of observability tooling (Kibana, Grafana, Prometheus), and a passion for introducing new practices.
* Advantage: AWS security depth (IAM, KMS, multi-account and multi-region architecture), or hands-on CSPM (e.g. Wiz) and SIEM engineering.
* Advantage: privacy engineering experience, or offensive security background or certifications (e.g. OSCP).

If this role excites you but you don't tick every box, we'd still like to hear from you.

## **Work perks**

* The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme
* 25 working days of holiday
* Newest MacBook models
* Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture
* Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family
* Comprehensive Medical Insurance
* Group Life and Income Protection Insurance
* A matched pension scheme up to a set limit
* Access to a discounted gym membership plan

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 days per year in the EU, of these, 21 days can be spent globally. For non-EU citizens, it's 21 days worldwide. This can be combined with time off for vacation or personal time.

Each year, you’ll be given a learning budget (starting at €3,000), and a total of up to 10 working days over a 2-year period to support your personal and professional development.

**Hybrid work**

Our hybrid model, with 2 recommended office days a week, gives you and your team the flexibility to decide if and when you want to work from home, and when to catch up in person.

**Equal opportunity**

We welcome applications from everybody, regardless of your background, identity, or life experiences. Job openings come with guides, not checklists. If you’re excited about a role, but don’t identify with every point in the ‘About you’ section, apply anyway – you might still be the perfect match!

London, United Kingdom

As a leading financial technology firm, we leverage cutting-edge technology to deliver liquidity to global markets as well as innovative, transparent trading solutions and industry standard-setting analytics tools to our clients. As a market maker, Virtu provides deep liquidity that helps to create more efficient markets around the world. Our market structure expertise, broad diversification, and execution technology enables us to provide competitive bids and offers in over 19,000 securities, at over 235 venues, in 36 countries worldwide.

Virtu offers a dynamic, meritocratic environment with a flat hierarchy. No finance background is necessary or expected. This is a great opportunity for the right candidate to kick start a career in the financial technology space.

Our team is a dedicated group of client relationship managers, traders , analysts and developers that are inspired by the unique and exciting challenges we solve every day. We are a flat organization and encourage our people to innovate and lean on their teammates for support and collaboration. We have fun, work hard and strive to be virtuous in all we do.

Our Analytics team is a global data, analytics, and advisory leader where we deliver actionable insights to our clients to help inform execution decisions, support trading strategies, and provide reliable measurement and analysis of trading outcomes. * Supporting internal and external clients in their use of Virtu's Analytics product suite

* Contribute to new sales, product initiatives, and thought leadership content

* 1-3 years of professional experience, ideally working in a financial institution. Talented graduates will also be considered.
* Excellent academic background. Business, Economics, or Data Analytics degrees preferred.
* Very strong written and verbal communication skills and can easily build new interpersonal relationships.
* Analytically minded, data-driven thinker.
* Highly self-motivated and self-disciplined individual who is detail and results-oriented.
* A team player who collaborates well and excels at collective team goals.
* Some experience in programming is a plus (python preferred). Must have desire to learn if less familiar.

# HR Director

**Location**  
Cardiff

**We’re Hiring: HR Director**

**Location:** Cardiff, with travel required across UK and Ireland operations as necessary. 

**Reporting To****:** Chief Executive Officer 

**Direct Reports:** HR and Payroll Officers and other HR team members as required. 

**About Vista** 

Vista is a specialist technology services business supporting customers across the retail and hospitality sectors in the UK and Ireland. The business operates in a fast-paced, operationally complex environment and is continuing to develop its people, governance and organisational capability to support future growth. 

**The Opportunity** 

This is an opportunity for an experienced HR leader to take ownership of the people strategy at a senior level, working directly with the CEO and Executive Team. The successful candidate will have the scope to modernise HR practices, influence business decision-making, strengthen governance, support organisational change and develop scalable people frameworks across the UK and Ireland. 

**Role Purpose** 

The HR Director is responsible for defining, implementing and leading the organisation’s people strategy across multiple operations throughout the United Kingdom and Ireland. As a member of the senior leadership team, the role provides strategic direction and governance across all aspects of human resources, ensuring the organisation attracts, develops, retains and engages the talent required to achieve its business objectives. 

The role is accountable for establishing a robust HR framework that supports organisational growth, operational excellence, legal compliance and a positive, inclusive workplace culture. The HR Director will provide expert leadership on employment law, organisational design, workforce planning, talent management, employee relations, reward, culture and change management, ensuring that people strategies directly support corporate goals. 

The successful candidate will lead a small HR team and manage relationships with external partners, ensuring the delivery of a professional, commercially focused and high-performing HR function that supports all areas of the business. 

**Key Priorities in the First 12 Months** 

* Develop and agree a clear people strategy aligned to business objectives and operational priorities.

* Review and strengthen HR governance, policies and employment law compliance across UK and Ireland operations.

* Build an effective HR operating model that supports managers and employees consistently.

* Improve workforce planning, succession planning and leadership capability.

* Strengthen HR reporting, people metrics and Board-level insight.

* Support organisational change, integration activity and business growth priorities.

**Key Responsibilities** 

**HR Strategy and Leadership** 

* Develop, own and deliver the organisation’s people strategy, ensuring alignment with corporate objectives, growth plans and operational priorities.

* Collaborate with the senior leadership team to shape and support the company’s overall strategy.

* Translate business strategy into practical people initiatives that drive organisational performance, employee engagement and retention.

* Provide expert advice and strategic guidance to the Executive Leadership Team and Board on all people-related matters.

* Lead organisational change programmes, restructures, acquisitions, integrations and transformation initiatives.

* Create and maintain a culture that promotes accountability, performance, inclusion, wellbeing and continuous improvement.

* Establish HR objectives, KPIs and reporting frameworks that demonstrate the contribution of people initiatives to business performance.

* Drive workforce planning strategies that support future growth, capability requirements and succession planning.

**Governance, Risk and Compliance** 

* Develop and maintain a comprehensive HR governance framework across all UK and Ireland operations.

* Ensure compliance with UK and Irish employment legislation, regulatory requirements and HR best practice.

* Oversee the development, implementation and regular review of HR policies, procedures, employee handbooks and staff terms and conditions.

* Ensure appropriate controls are in place for recruitment, onboarding, performance management, disciplinary procedures, grievance handling, employee exits and payroll-related HR processes.

* Maintain comprehensive HR records to support equal opportunities, data protection, audit requirements and informed decision-making.

* Support business compliance requirements, audits, due diligence reviews and regulatory assessments.

* Monitor legislative developments and ensure organisational readiness for changes in employment law.

* Work with legal advisers where required on employment litigation, tribunal claims and other workforce-related risks.

**Employment Law and Employee Relations** 

* Provide expert guidance on complex employment law matters across multiple jurisdictions within the UK and Ireland.

* Lead the management of employee relations cases including disciplinary matters, grievances, performance improvement plans, capability procedures, redundancy programmes and TUPE matters.

* Provide expert and well-balanced employee relations advice, including negotiation with employee representatives where required.

* Ensure consistent and legally compliant application of employment policies and practices throughout the organisation.

* Lead consultation processes relating to organisational changes, restructures and workforce transformation programmes.

* Reduce organisational risk through proactive employee relations management, effective communication and robust governance practices.

**Organisational Development and Talent Management** 

* Develop workforce planning strategies that support current and future business requirements.

* Lead succession planning and talent management initiatives across the organisation.

* Deliver leadership development programmes that strengthen management capability.

* Ensure effective recruitment and onboarding processes that attract and retain high-quality talent within agreed budgets.

* Develop performance management frameworks that support accountability, capability development and career progression.

* Identify skills gaps and implement development programmes to build organisational capability.

* Support the development of a diverse, inclusive and high-performing workforce.

* Research and develop practices that help the company recruit and retain a pool of well-trained and highly motivated employees.

**Reward, Benefits and Payroll Oversight** 

* Lead the organisation’s compensation, benefits and reward strategy.

* Recommend and implement reward policies and structures that support the recruitment and retention of high-quality employees.

* Ensure reward structures remain competitive, equitable and aligned with business objectives.

* Provide strategic recommendations to the Executive Team on salary benchmarking, incentive schemes, benefits and recognition programmes.

* Oversee pension arrangements, employee benefit programmes and wellbeing initiatives across the organisation.

* Maintain a comprehensive understanding of end-to-end payroll processes and regulations, ensuring effective HR oversight of payroll-related activity.

* Ensure reward practices are compliant with relevant employment legislation and support the organisation’s diversity, equity and inclusion objectives.

**Leadership and Team Management** 

* Lead, coach and develop a high-performing HR team.

* Responsible for the recruitment, development and succession planning of the HR department.

* Establish clear objectives, performance measures, regular one-to-ones, appraisals and development plans for team members.

* Prioritise and delegate HR activity effectively while maintaining positive communication, morale and service quality.

* Ensure the HR team provides a professional, practical and confidential HR service across the organisation.

* Oversee HR operations across UK and Ireland operations, including SCT in Ireland, attending sites where necessary and implementing consistent HR practices across teams.

* Work with department managers to analyse department needs and build business cases for additional resources and changes to structure to the CEO and CFO where required.

* Manage key external HR partners, including employment law advisers, recruitment providers, training organisations and benefits providers.

**Stakeholder Management and Reporting** 

* Build strong relationships with Directors, senior managers and operational leaders.

* Influence decision-making through data-driven insights, commercial understanding and strategic recommendations.

* Represent the HR function at Board and Executive meetings where required.

* Complete documentation, reporting and monthly HR updates on time and in line with company standards.

* Liaise with senior management on matters that may affect organisational performance, resourcing or budgetary requirements.

* Collaborate effectively with Finance, Operations, Commercial and Compliance teams to support organisational objectives.

* Ensure people considerations are embedded into key business decisions and strategic planning activities.

* Be flexible and prepared to undertake any other appropriate duties designated from time to time by the management team to meet business needs.

**Key Challenges and Complexities** 

The HR Director will operate in a complex, multi-site environment across the United Kingdom and Ireland, requiring the ability to navigate differing employment legislation, regulatory environments and workforce practices while maintaining consistency of approach and high-quality HR service delivery. 

* Ensuring compliance with UK and Irish employment legislation and evolving case law.

* Managing organisational growth, acquisitions, integrations and business transformation programmes.

* Balancing commercial objectives with employee wellbeing, legal obligations and organisational culture.

* Leading sensitive employee relations matters with significant legal, financial and reputational implications.

* Supporting a diverse workforce operating across multiple locations, customer environments and jurisdictions.

* Influencing senior stakeholders and driving strategic change throughout the organisation.

* Developing scalable people frameworks capable of supporting future organisational growth.

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience** 

**Essential Experience** 

* Significant senior HR leadership experience, ideally as an HR Director, Head of HR or equivalent.

* Proven experience developing and implementing organisation-wide people strategies.

* Experience supporting multi-site operations across the UK and Ireland.

* Extensive experience managing complex employee relations matters and employment law issues.

* Experience supporting organisational growth, transformation, acquisitions or integration programmes.

* Experience leading, developing and mentoring HR professionals.

* Experience advising Executive Teams and Boards on strategic people matters.

* Strong experience working within commercially focused and operationally complex organisations.

* Experience of working within a unionised environment is desirable.

* IT or technology sector experience is desirable.

**Essential Knowledge and Skills** 

* Expert knowledge of UK employment law and HR best practice.

* Strong understanding of Irish employment legislation and associated compliance requirements.

* Working knowledge of relevant European employment law principles and emerging legislative developments.

* Knowledge of organisational development, change management, workforce planning, governance, risk and compliance processes.

* Knowledge of compensation, reward, benefits, payroll processes, HR systems, workforce analytics and HR technology platforms.

* Strategic thinking and long-term planning capability.

* Ability to create, articulate and execute business-aligned people strategies.

* Exceptional communication, presentation, negotiation, conflict resolution and influencing skills.

* Strong commercial awareness, business acumen and analytical capability.

* Ability to build credibility and influence at Executive and Board level.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities within a dynamic environment.

* High levels of judgement, resilience and professional integrity.

**Qualifications** 

**Essential** 

* Degree level qualification or equivalent professional experience.

* CIPD Level 7 qualification or Chartered Member/Chartered Fellow of the Chartered Institute of Personnel and Development.

* Evidence of continuous professional development in HR leadership, employment law and organisational development.

* Significant HR experience, including substantial experience in a senior HR leadership role.

**Desirable** 

* Master’s degree in human resources, Business Management, Organisational Psychology or a related discipline.

* Additional qualifications in employment law, organisational development, executive coaching or business leadership.

* Project management, change management or transformation-related qualifications.

**Personal Profile** 

The ideal candidate will be a commercially minded and credible HR leader with the ability to create a compelling vision for the people agenda and translate that vision into measurable business outcomes. They will combine deep technical HR expertise with pragmatic judgement, strong stakeholder management and the ability to influence, challenge and support Executive and Board-level decision-making. 

* Proven ability to develop and execute organisation-wide HR strategies.

* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to align people initiatives to business objectives.

* Experience operating across multiple locations and jurisdictions.

* Strong leadership capability with experience managing and developing small teams.

* Exceptional communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.

* Experience leading organisational change, transformation and cultural development programmes.

* High levels of integrity, professionalism and sound judgement.

* A proactive and pragmatic approach to problem solving within complex operational environments.

**What Success Looks Like** 

* A clear, business-aligned people strategy is agreed and delivered.

* HR governance, employment law compliance and people-related risk are strengthened across UK and Ireland operations.

* Employee engagement, retention, succession planning and talent development improve over time.

* Managers receive practical, consistent and commercially focused HR support.

* Board and Executive reporting provides meaningful insight into workforce trends, risks and opportunities.

* The HR function operates as a professional, trusted and high-performing partner to the business.

**Benefits and Candidate Proposition** 

* Competitive salary and annual leave entitlement.

* Private healthcare.

* Group Income Protection plan.

* Life assurance plan.

* Executive Team exposure and the opportunity to shape the people strategy across UK and Ireland operations.

* The ability to build a modern HR function with direct impact on culture, governance and business performance.

**Equal Opportunities** 

Vista is committed to creating an inclusive working environment where everyone is treated with dignity and respect. We welcome applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. 

This role is ideally suited to an experienced HR leader who can shape and deliver a modern people strategy, provide robust governance across multiple jurisdictions, and build a high-performing workforce that supports Vista’s long-term growth ambitions.

# Salesforce Product Owner

**Hybrid**ITFull time

London, England, United Kingdom

OverviewApplication

## Description

Vizrt is looking for a Salesforce Product Owner to take genuine end-to-end ownership of the Salesforce platform — not just the roadmap and backlog, but the business outcomes that roadmap is meant to deliver. This is a senior, business-facing role for someone able to define what “good” looks like for the platform, defend that definition against competing stakeholder demands, and see it through to delivery via an offshore development team. Agentforce is imminent on our platform, and this role will shape how AI-enabled features — including agentic capability in Sales and Service — make their way onto the roadmap responsibly.

This role sits deliberately close to delivery: the successful candidate will own outcome definition and acceptance criteria personally, while translation into detailed, implementation-ready user stories is carried out in partnership with an offshore delivery lead. The Product Owner is accountable for delivery of the roadmap and holds formal or, at minimum, strong influence-based authority — backed by a named escalation path — over prioritisation of the offshore delivery lead’s work, so that accountability is matched by real authority.

## Requirements

***Outcome ownership & roadmap***

•       Define and own the Salesforce product roadmap in terms of the business outcomes it is intended to deliver (e.g. adoption, process efficiency, revenue enablement) — not just the list of features being built.

•       Set and defend prioritisation of the roadmap and backlog against competing demands from Sales, Marketing, and Customer Service, making trade-off calls rather than simply relaying stakeholder requests.

•       Define acceptance criteria and success measures for each roadmap item in outcome terms (e.g. adoption rate, cycle time, business KPI movement), not just delivery/completion status.

***Delivery accountability***

•       Hold end-to-end accountability for delivery of the roadmap, including through the offshore development team.

•       Hold formal or influence-based authority — with a committed escalation and resolution path — over the offshore delivery lead’s priorities, to reprioritise work when roadmap needs shift or delivery is at risk.

•       Partner with the offshore delivexry lead to translate outcome-level intent and acceptance criteria into detailed, implementation-ready user stories, retaining review and sign-off authority over how requirements are interpreted before build begins.

•       Monitor delivery progress against roadmap commitments and intervene early when scope, quality, or timeline risk threatens the outcome, rather than only tracking output volume.

***Stakeholder & governance***

•       Act as the primary point of accountability for the Salesforce platform’s business value with senior stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Customer Service, and IT.

•       Chair or actively participate in a prioritisation/governance forum where cross-functional conflicts over Salesforce demand — including proposed agent deployments — are resolved.

•       Build enough platform and Salesforce domain credibility to engage technical conversations with the Salesforce Technical Architect and Development Lead as a peer, not just a business proxy.

***AI-enabled roadmap & Agentforce***

•       Drive adoption of Agentforce-based agents in Sales and Service Cloud contexts, partnering closely with business stakeholders, who retain final sign-off and accountability for deploying any customer- or business-facing agent into production.

•      Maintain a working understanding of AI/agent governance considerations (data grounding, guardrails, observability) sufficient to identify and escalate risk early — while final production risk sign-off for business-facing agents sits with the business.

**Your Profile**

You think and act like a product owner, not a backlog administrator: you are comfortable defining what should be built and why, saying no to requests that don’t move the needle, and being held accountable for the outcome rather than just the output. You are equally comfortable operating at the level of business strategy and getting close enough to delivery detail to write or review a clear acceptance criterion. Experience managing distributed or offshore delivery teams — and the discipline that requires around clear, unambiguous requirements — is important, because ambiguity that would cost minutes to resolve locally can cost days across time zones.

You have strong, AI-literate product judgment: you can weigh the business value of an AI-enabled or agentic feature against its risk, and you are comfortable building that expertise on the job as Agentforce becomes part of the platform. Prior hands-on experience with Salesforce Agentforce or comparable agentic AI tooling is a genuine advantage but not a requirement.

**Skills and Experience**

•       6+ years in a product owner, product manager, or equivalent business-facing platform ownership role, ideally including accountability for a delivery roadmap through a distributed or offshore team.

•       Strong working knowledge of Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud — to engage credibly with technical architects and challenge technical trade-offs, not necessarily hands-on configuration experience.

•       Demonstrated experience prioritising competing stakeholder demands and defending trade-off decisions with senior stakeholders.

•       Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, and communication skills — this is a core requirement, not an advantage.

•       Experience writing or reviewing detailed acceptance criteria and user stories, and working with an offshore or nearshore delivery team.

•       Strong product judgment on AI-enabled features — able to assess the value and risk of introducing AI/agentic capability into production. Hands-on Agentforce or agentic AI implementation experience is a plus, not a must-have.

This role offers the opportunity to define, own, and be genuinely accountable for how Salesforce — including its emerging agentic capabilities — delivers business value at Vizrt, with the authority to match that accountability.

## Benefits

4 billion humans see the stories that our customers tell every day. So, for us diversity is not an optional objective, it is a simple reality. Our customers’ customers are diverse, our customers are diverse, Vizrt gains strength from being diverse.

It is true that we hold our diversity to be essential, it is something we constantly nourish and pay attention to, but it is not something we take for granted. We do not tolerate discrimination or harassment. We champion inclusion and we value each other’s stories, and we relish their telling

* Paid Time Off: Generous vacation days, sick leave, and holidays to ensure you have a work-life balance
* Professional Development: Opportunities for ongoing training

Join our team and take advantage of these benefits while working in a dynamic and supportive environment

Strong data architecture and engineering expertise, with the ability to communicate complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

* Experience designing or improving volume-hiring campaigns, recruitment events, or structured assessment processes.

This is a full-time, 12-month fixed-term contract based in our King's Cross office in London. Time together in our offices and operational environments helps fuel innovation, culture, relationships, and learning.

# Graduate Analyst Programme - Healthcare Strategy & Operations

## Values-led. Pace-driven. Be an exceptional graduate shaping operational excellence in private healthcare. Where judgement, delivery and disciplined performance differentiate.

### Graduate Analyst Programme - Healthcare Strategy & Operations

**London | November Start**

Welbeck is looking for ambitious graduates with strong data analytics skills and hands-on Power BI experience. Over 12 months, you will use data to help leaders make better decisions about healthcare capacity, workforce, investment and patient experience.

You will work directly with operational leaders, clinicians and executives across our London, Oxford and Cambridge centres, taking responsibility for analysis that informs real decisions. You will work on live projects rather than rotating between departments. Expect complex questions, imperfect information and the chance to see your recommendations put into practice.

### **What you will do**

· **Dashboards.** Build clear, interactive Power BI dashboards that bring together operational, workforce and commercial data to track performance and highlight where action is needed.

· **Data people can trust.** Clean, combine and validate data from multiple sources, define consistent measures and document assumptions so colleagues can trust and reproduce your analysis.

· **Workforce and performance.** Analyse trends in retention, productivity and service performance, test possible explanations and distinguish evidence from assumption.

· **Capacity and patient flow.** Evaluate opportunities to expand capacity and improve theatre utilisation and patient flow, balancing commercial value with patient safety and experience.

· **Investment cases.** Model the financial and operational impact of investment and process changes, testing how different assumptions affect the recommendation.

· **Recommendations**. Present concise recommendations to senior leaders, explain the limitations of the evidence and help measure whether agreed changes deliver the intended improvements.

### **What you will gain**

You will build commercial judgement, a practical understanding of how healthcare services operate and experience in business intelligence, strategy and operational improvement. Working with leaders and clinicians, you will learn to frame the right question, defend your analysis and communicate findings to people with different priorities.

This is a fixed-term programme. Graduates who perform strongly will be may be considered for permanent roles in analytics, strategy or operational management as they arise.

### **What you will bring**

We are looking for analytical ability, intellectual curiosity and sound judgement. Your evidence can come from university projects, a dissertation, internships, employment or personal projects. Prior healthcare experience is not required.

### **Essential**

· **Power BI.** Hands-on experience building clear, interactive Power BI reports.

· **Data analysis.** Cleaning and validating data, investigating trends and outliers, applying sound statistical reasoning and turning findings into recommendations.

· **Excel.** Formulas, lookups and pivot tables, with the ability to check calculations and build structured models.

· **Communication.** Explaining complex findings simply, with effective visuals, and answering questions about your methods and assumptions.

· **Judgement**. Challenging assumptions, working through ambiguity and knowing when more evidence or guidance is needed.

· **Care.** Attention to detail, resilience and discretion with confidential information.

**Desirable**

· **Advanced Power BI.** Power Query, data modelling and table relationships, and DAX measures.

· **Coding**. SQL, Python or R.

· **A quantitative degree.** STEM or another quantitative discipline.

### Our values

Our values, CAKE, shape how we work and how we hire. This is what they mean in this role.

· **Collaboration.** “We share skills and knowledge in the pursuit of the greater good.” You will agree measures with clinical, operational and finance colleagues, so everyone uses the same numbers.

· **Ambition.** “We are open to new ideas and speak up when we see better ways of working.” You will question how things are measured and propose better ways to track and improve performance.

· **Kindness.** “We are thoughtful, respectful and show consideration to those around us.” Behind every data point is a patient or a colleague, so you will handle data and findings with care.

· **Empowerment.** “We create a safe space to try, learn and excel.” You will own your analysis from question to recommendation, with room to try new approaches and learn.

**Minimum eligibility**

· A 2:1 undergraduate degree (upper second-class honours) or equivalent, in any discipline.

· The right to work in the UK from November 2026 for the full programme. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship.

· Available to start in November 2026 and work full time, with three days a week on site in London.

· Able to attend the in-person assessment day in London.

Product Engineering builds the end‐to‐end product experiences that Workday customers use. Many of these experiences are now powered by agents and AI, which depend on a strong API foundation.

* Define and evolve the API architecture, standards, and review processes that guide how Product Engineering teams design and deliver APIs.
* Partner with product and platform leaders to shape the operating model, including API champions across product pillars and a clear intake/prioritization path for API needs.
* Help Product Engineering teams think through product design, domain modeling, service boundaries, and API endpoints that support end-to-end product functionality.
* Ensure APIs are designed not only as technical interfaces, but as durable product contracts that reflect clear product capabilities, domain concepts, and customer use cases.
